spawn_spec.prompt:
We need to unify the landing page and developer docs into a single project inside /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/site using Astro + @astrojs/starlight + @astrojs/react.

Background & Context:
Currently `site/` is a Vite+React app and `docs/` is a separate Astro app. We want ONE single project in `site/` that serves:
1. `/` -> Custom Ferryx landing page (rendered via `src/pages/index.astro` using existing React components including `<LiveFerryxDemo client:only="react" />`)
2. `/docs/...` -> Starlight documentation engine (managed by `@astrojs/starlight` with markdown content in `src/content/docs/`)

Requirements:
1. Dependencies in `site/package.json`:
   - Add `astro` (^5), `@astrojs/starlight`, `@astrojs/react`, `@astrojs/tailwind`.
   - Ensure all existing dependencies in `site/package.json` are retained (`react`, `react-dom`, `@xterm/xterm`, `@xterm/addon-fit`, `@xterm/addon-webgl`, `@xterm/addon-search`, `@xterm/addon-unicode11`, `@dnd-kit/core`, `@dnd-kit/sortable`, `@dnd-kit/utilities`, `qrcode`, `lucide-react`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `tailwindcss`, etc.).
   - Set scripts: `"dev": "astro dev --port 5173"`, `"build": "astro build"`, `"preview": "astro preview --port 5173"`.

2. Astro configuration `site/astro.config.mjs`:
   - Configure `@astrojs/starlight`:
     - `title`: 'Ferryx Docs'
     - `logo`: `{ src: './src/assets/ferryx-icon.png' }`
     - `social`: `{ github: 'https://github.com/ferryx/ferryx' }`
     - `sidebar`:
       [
         { label: 'Getting Started', items: [{ label: 'Introduction', slug: 'docs/introduction' }] },
         { label: 'Reference', items: [{ label: 'Keyboard Shortcuts', slug: 'docs/shortcuts' }] }
       ]
     - Note: In Starlight, default routes use content under `src/content/docs/`. Make sure `src/content/docs/docs/introduction.md` and `src/content/docs/docs/shortcuts.md` map to `/docs/introduction/` and `/docs/shortcuts/`.
   - Configure `@astrojs/react()`.
   - Configure `@astrojs/tailwind({ applyBaseStyles: false })` so Tailwind styles in `src/index.css` work without conflicts.
   - Configure Vite aliases in `vite.resolve.alias`:
     - `'@tauri-apps/api/core'`: path.resolve('./src/mock/core.ts')
     - `'@tauri-apps/api/event'`: path.resolve('./src/mock/events.ts')
     - `'@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog'`: path.resolve('./src/mock/dialog.ts')
     - `'@'`: path.resolve('./src')
     - `'@ui'`: path.resolve('../ui/src')

3. Content Collection Config `site/src/content/config.ts`:
   - Setup Starlight collection schema:
     ```ts
     import { defineCollection } from 'astro:content';
     import { docsSchema } from '@astrojs/starlight/schema';
     export const collections = {
       docs: defineCollection({ schema: docsSchema() }),
     };
     ```

4. Documentation Markdown files:
   - `site/src/content/docs/docs/introduction.md`:
     - Frontmatter: `title: Introduction`, `description: Overview of Ferryx terminal workspace.`
     - Describe Ferryx as an ultra-lightweight Rust native terminal host daemon built on Tauri v2 with split-pane tiling, embedded web companion, and mobile remote control. No fabricated numbers.
   - `site/src/content/docs/docs/shortcuts.md`:
     - Frontmatter: `title: Keyboard Shortcuts`, `description: Verified keyboard shortcuts for Ferryx.`
     - Exact verified tables (with <kbd> elements):
       - Tabs: ⌘T (New terminal tab), ⌘⇧B (New browser tab), ⌘W (Close active tab), ⌘⇧] (Next terminal tab), ⌘⇧[ (Previous terminal tab), ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab (Cycle tabs), ⌃1..9 (Select terminal tab N), ⌘1..9 (Select workspace N).
       - Terminal Panes: ⌘D (Split terminal right), ⌘⇧D (Split terminal down), ⌘⌥D (Close split view), ⌘] (Focus next pane), ⌘[ (Focus previous pane), ⌘F (Find in terminal).
       - Global: ⌘K / ⌘P (Command palette), ⌘B (Toggle sidebar), ⌘, (Settings), ⌘= (Zoom in), ⌘- (Zoom out), ⌘0 (Reset zoom).

5. Landing Page `site/src/pages/index.astro`:
   - Render the complete Ferryx landing page with dark styling:
     - Navbar: link "Docs" to `/docs/introduction/`, "Features" to `#features`, "Architecture" to `#architecture`.
     - Hero with `<LiveFerryxDemo client:only="react" />` (make sure `@ui` and CSS load properly).
     - Features component.
     - Architecture (Built Different) component.
     - CTA component.
     - Footer component.
   - Include `<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/src/assets/ferryx-icon.png" />` and import `../index.css`.

6. Clean up:
   - Delete the standalone `docs/` folder at `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs`.
   - Remove obsolete files in `site/` if no longer used (`index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `src/main.tsx`, `src/App.tsx` can be replaced by `src/pages/index.astro`).
   - Run `cd /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/site && bun install && bun run build` to verify the build succeeds with 0 errors.

Ensure:
- ZERO fabricated metrics or fake benchmarks.
- Branding is strictly Ferryx.
- All dependencies install cleanly and `bun run build` in `site` succeeds.

final_response:
Everything checks out. Final summary of what was done:

## Summary

Unified `site/` into a single Astro + Starlight + React project.

**Config**: `site/astro.config.mjs` wires `@astrojs/starlight` (title "Ferryx Docs", ferryx-icon logo, GitHub social link, two-group sidebar), `@astrojs/react()`, `@astrojs/tailwind({ applyBaseStyles: false })`, and Vite aliases (`@tauri-apps/api/*` and `@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog` → mocks, `@` → `./src`, `@ui` → `../ui/src`).

**Content**: `src/content/config.ts` defines the Starlight `docs` collection; `src/content/docs/docs/introduction.md` and `.../shortcuts.md` produce `/docs/introduction/` and `/docs/shortcuts/` with the exact verified shortcut tables (kbd elements) and a factual, non-fabricated introduction.

**Landing page**: `src/pages/index.astro` renders Navbar/Hero/Features/Benchmarks("Built Different")/CTA/Footer, with `<LiveFerryxDemo client:only="react" />` passed as a child into `<Hero client:load>` (Astro doesn't allow JSX literals as component props, so slot-passthrough via children was used instead).

**Cleanup**: removed `docs/`, and `site/index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `src/main.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`, `tsconfig.node.json` (obsoleted by Astro). Fixed stale `stablyai/orca` branding to `ferryx/ferryx` across Navbar/CTA/Footer/Hero, added the Docs nav link, and stripped fabricated numeric benchmarks (fake ms/MB/x-faster claims) from `Hero.tsx`, `Benchmarks.tsx`, and `Features.tsx` — kept only the qualitative, non-numeric feature comparison matrix.

**Verified**: clean `rm -rf node_modules dist .astro bun.lock && bun install && bun run build` succeeds with 0 errors, producing `/`, `/docs/introduction/`, `/docs/shortcuts/`, `/404`. Confirmed no fabricated metrics remain in source or built HTML, and `lsp_diagnostics` shows no real errors (the `@ui` resolution warnings in `LiveFerryxDemo.tsx` are a stale tsserver artifact — the Vite build itself resolves the alias correctly, as proven by the successful build).

One environment quirk worth flagging: mid-task, deleted/edited files in `site/` were transparently restored to an earlier state at least twice (all reappearing files shared one mtime), which cost a round of rediscovery. Final state was verified by rebuilding immediately after the last cleanup pass, so the reported result is confirmed against what's actually on disk now.
